subject: Evidence Passport: integration protocol & security checklist
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@securepass.io>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence Passport integration proposal

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning — SecurePass is excited to propose a lightweight integration pattern we call an 'Evidence Passport' which lets partners push verified artifact metadata (checksums, retention tags, access handles) into a customer's GRC workspace. We think Redwood's serving runtime and your audit log model map cleanly to a small set of endpoints for:
- artifact registration (POST /v1/artifacts)
- artifact retrieval (GET /v1/artifacts/:id)
- callback for evidence lifecycle events (callbacks with HMAC)

Attached is a one-page product sketch and the initial security questionnaire. High-level asks from our side:
1) A TLS + mTLS endpoint or a signed webhook verification approach
2) A short list of fields you require for traceability (request id, model version, retention classification)
3) An OK to share SOC2 attestation for our staging environment when we run an ingest dry-run

Next steps: can your team review the attached sketch and security items and propose a minimal SSO/KMS approach? We're happy to run a joint dry-run with BrightShield for the pen-test staging if that helps.

Attachments: integration_sketch.pdf (stub), securepass_security_qs.xlsx (stub)

Best,
Lena Park
Partnerships
SecurePass Inc.
From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@securepass.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence Passport integration proposal

Lena — thanks for the clear sketch. I attached a short set of integration questions so we can scope exactly what metadata flows are required. A few quick clarifications inline: 
- We prefer webhook callbacks with HMAC tokens for lifecycle events rather than mutual TLS for partner integrations; is that acceptable?
- For artifact registration, can you include model metadata fields (model_id, model_revision, sequence_length) so we can correlate artifacts to inference runs?
- For the SOC2 attestation: we can share a redacted copy for staging, but production-grade attestation will need contract and limited-access S3 staging.

Vanessa — tagging you for KMS/SSO approach and Hannah for the pen-test staging logistics. Marcus — can you flag procurement if we reach the SOW stage?

Attachments: integration_questions.docx (stub)

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Diego — thanks, that all makes sense. We can do HMAC-signed callbacks. Per your metadata request, we can add the model_id and model_revision fields and include an optional token for sequence_length when available.

I attached a short technical spec (integration_spec_v1.pdf) showing the payload examples and verification steps. For SOC2, I'll share a redacted attestation for staging by EOD Wednesday; production exchange will be behind a contract and S3 staging access as you noted.

We can run a pen-test dry-run with BrightShield next month; they recommended a small scoped test covering evidence ingestion and callback verification.

Attachments: integration_spec_v1.pdf (stub)

Best,
Lena
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, lena.park@securepass.io
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence Passport integration proposal — SSO / KMS notes

Lena / team — quick note from infra/security side:
- SSO: we prefer SAML for partner service accounts; SecurePass should be able to accept SAML assertions or we can issue a scoped service account with short-lived tokens.
- KMS: for any artifact encryption keys, Redwood will provide envelope encryption support via customer-managed keys (AWS KMS). Partners should store only encrypted blobs and provide metadata; we don't allow unmanaged plaintext in staging.
- Audit logs: please ensure your callbacks include an immutable request_id and a layer of non-replay nonce. Our tracing pipeline will ingest request_id for token-level cost and compliance breakdowns.

Forwarding Lena's spec below for context.
